meta.name: pet-commerce-creator
meta.description: 萌宠带货短视频全流程创作技能，基于COZE视频大模型API，支持萌宠剧情/好物测评/品种科普/宠品带货等全类型创作，覆盖爆款解析反推、知识库联动、互动优化、素材批量下载、全素材整合，实现从创意到带货引流型成品视频的自动化生成，适配15-30秒竖屏9:16主流平台规格。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成萌宠带货短视频，适配竖屏规格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要做萌宠类带货短视频，从创意到成品一键生成
copy.tagline_en: Auto-generate pet e-commerce short videos in vertical format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create pet e-commerce short videos from idea to final product

howto.what: Claude会按你的要求创作萌宠带货短视频：从解析爆款链接、写脚本分镜，到生成图片、字幕、音效，再合成15-30秒竖屏9:16的成品视频，支持剧情、测评、科普、带货等类型。
howto.when: 当你提出萌宠短视频创作需求（故事、测评、科普等），或给出视频链接要求解析反推时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个B站链接解析成爆款参考
say.note: 会下载视频并生成解析报告，自动存入知识库。

say.text: 创作一个15秒的猫粮测评带货视频
say.note: 会走完整流程，输出成品视频和素材包。

say.text: 根据点赞率85%优化上一版视频
say.note: 会分析互动数据，回溯修改并重新合成。

howto.what_en: Claude will create pet-commerce short videos based on your request: parse viral links, write scripts and storyboards, generate images, subtitles, sound effects, and composite a 15-30s vertical 9:16 video. Supports story, review, science, and shopping types.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for pet short video creation (story, review, science, etc.) or provide a video link for viral analysis.

say_en.text: Parse this Bilibili link into a viral reference.
say_en.note: Downloads the video and creates a report stored in the knowledge base.

say_en.text: Create a 15-second cat food review shopping video.
say_en.note: Runs the full pipeline and outputs the final video plus assets.

say_en.text: Optimize the previous video based on 85% like rate.
say_en.note: Analyzes interaction data, revises, and re-composites the video.
